jobs.title: 🎉 Frost & Sullivan recognizes Scytale as Global Customer Value Leader.
jobs.description: Frost & Sullivan named Scytale the Global Customer Value Leader in Compliance Automation Frost & Sullivan recognized Scytale as the defining standard in compliance automation, for combining agentic AI with embedded compliance expertise into a single, continuously proactive platform, delivering measurable, sustained value for customers. Download the full report Why the analysts recognized Scytale One platform, not a stack of point solutions. 150+ integrations and cross-framework mapping mean a single control can satisfy multiple frameworks, instead of duplicate work. AI that acts, not just alerts. Agentic architecture detects compliance gaps, validates evidence, drafts policies, and orchestrates remediation continuously, providing always-on validation. Human expertise built into automation. Dedicated compliance experts tailor onboarding to each customer environment and provide hands-on expertise through audit preparation, control validation, as well as the audit. 70–90% reduction in audit preparation time, 60–80% less manual evidence collection effort, and 4–8 weeks to audit readiness (vs. 3–6 months industry norm) A defining aspect of Scytale’s approach lies in its agentic GRC ecosystem, where a suite of specialized AI-driven compliance agents performs tasks such as gap detection, evidence validation, policy analysis, and third-party risk intelligence. Rabin Dhakal Best Practices Research Analyst, Frost & Sullivan The full report covers: Why the market is shifting from point-in-time audits to always-on compliance How Scytale's agentic AI architecture works, end to end What 70–90% faster audits actually means for time-to-market Download the full report

jobs.description: Forget about compliance as you know it. Scy is your next-gen, GRC-savvy AI Agent. Scy breaks down GRC barriers, where speed and convenience drive every workflow. Scytale scans and flags any vulnerabilities in your security and compliance management system 24/7, giving you full control and real-time visibility. Ensure you remain compliant all year round by automatically monitoring the effectiveness of your controls post-audit. Automate and manage multiple frameworks in one place. Leverage controls already mapped from other security standards and regulations and gain full visibility across your entire compliance program by managing all your frameworks in one centralized hub. “Continuous control monitoring feature allows us to make sure we are always on top of our compliance. It’s a real game-changer.” Read our reviews on Round-the-clock compliance monitoring. Transform time-intensive, outdated and redundant compliance checks into a streamlined and continuous compliance process that happens in the background. 24/7 compliance assurance Run on-demand tests on your data AI-powered risk visibility and management Reduce dependency on your team Real-time reporting and insights 24/7 compliance assurance Instead of relying on annual, point-in-time audits to verify your compliance, ensure you’re in a constant state of compliance with continuous control checks automatically running in the background. Run on-demand tests on your data Identify any compliance gaps before the auditor, enabling fast remediation and preventing any bigger challenges evolving from non-compliance.
